description_en: Updates the configuration of a function
kebab_example: aliyun fc-open update-function --if-match e19d5cd5af0378da05f63f891c7467af --service-name demoService --function-name demoFunction --x-fc-account-id 1880770869020000 --x-fc-code-checksum 1506052139770049xxxx --x-fc-date Wed,_11_May_2022_09:00:00_GMT --x-fc-trace-id test-trace-id --api-version 2021-04-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateFunction

parameters.help_en: Used to ensure that the resource to be modified is the same as the expected resource. The value is obtained from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415747.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415750.html, or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415749.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 用于确保实际更改的资源和期望更改的资源是一致的，该值来自https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415747.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415750.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415749.html的响应
parameters.name: if_match

parameters.help_en: The name of the service
parameters.help_zh: 服务名称
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the function
parameters.help_zh: 函数名称
parameters.name: function_name

fields.help_en: The name of the Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket that stores the ZIP package of the function code
fields.help_zh: 存放函数代码ZIP包的OSS Bucket名称
fields.name: oss_bucket_name

fields.help_en: The name of the OSS object (ZIP package) that contains the function code
fields.help_zh: 存放函数代码ZIP包的OSS Object名称
fields.name: oss_object_name

fields.help_en: The ZIP package of the function code that is encoded in Base64 format
fields.help_zh: 函数代码ZIP包的Base 64编码
fields.name: zip_file

parameters.help_en:
The **Code** struct. You can use one of the following two methods to provide the function code package. You must use one and only one of these methods in a request:

- Specify **ossBucketName** and **ossObjectName** that store the code package.

- Specify **zipFile** as the Base64-encoded content of the ZIP package
parameters.help_zh:
**Code**支持两种方式提供函数代码包，在一次请求中必须且只能使用其中一种：

- 指定存储代码包的**ossBucketName**和**ossObjectName**。
- 指定**zipFile**为ZIP包的Base64编码内容
parameters.name: code

fields.help_en: The startup argument of the container
fields.help_zh: 容器启动参数
fields.name: args

fields.help_en: The startup command of the container
fields.help_zh: 容器启动命令
fields.name: command

fields.help_en: The endpoint of the container image
fields.help_zh: 容器镜像地址
fields.name: image

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable image acceleration. Valid values:

*   **Default**: enables image acceleration.
*   **None**: disables image acceleration
fields.help_zh:
是否开启镜像加速。
  * **Default**：默认值，表示开启镜像加速。
  * **None**：表示关闭镜像加速
fields.name: acceleration_type

fields.help_en: The ID of the image repository for the Container Registry Enterprise Edition. You must specify this parameter if you use an image of Container Registry Enterprise Edition
fields.help_zh: ACR企业版镜像仓库ID，使用ACR企业版镜像时须传入
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the web server mode. Valid values:

*   true (default): enables web server mode. In this case, web servers must be implemented in container images to listen for and process requests.
*   false: disables web server mode. In this case, the container exits the process after running and the exit code must be 0
fields.help_zh:
镜像运行是否为Web Server模式。
- 取值为true表示需要在容器镜像中实现Web Server来监听端口并处理请求。
- 取值为false表示需要容器运行后主动退出进程，并且ExitCode需要为0。

默认值为true
fields.name: web_server_mode

parameters.help_en: The configuration of the Custom Container runtime. After you configure this parameter, the function can be executed using a custom container image
parameters.help_zh: Custom Container运行时的相关配置。配置后函数可以使用自定义容器镜像执行函数
parameters.name: custom_container_config

parameters.help_en:
A list of layers.

> Multiple layers are merged in descending order of the array index. The content of a layer with a smaller index overwrites the file with the same name in a layer with a larger index
parameters.help_zh:
层的列表。
> 多个层会按照数组下标从大到小的顺序进行合并，下标小的层的内容会覆盖下标大的层的同名文件
parameters.name: layers

parameters.help_en: The description of the function
parameters.help_zh: 函数描述
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The environment variables that you want to configure for the function. You can obtain the values of the environment variables in the function. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69777.html
parameters.help_zh: 为函数设置的环境变量，可以在函数中获取环境变量的值。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69777.html
parameters.name: environment_variables

parameters.help_en: The entry point for function execution. The format varies based on the programming language. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157704.html
parameters.help_zh: 函数执行的入口，具体格式和语言相关。详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157704.html
parameters.name: handler

parameters.help_en: The memory size of the function in MB. The value must be a multiple of 64. The memory size varies by instance type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179379.html
parameters.help_zh: 函数的内存规格，单位为MB，内存大小为64 MB的倍数。不同的函数实例类型，内存规格存在差异。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179379.html
parameters.name: memory_size

parameters.help_en: The runtime environment of the function. Valid values: **nodejs20**, **nodejs18**, **nodejs16**, **nodejs14**, **nodejs12**, **nodejs10**, **nodejs8**, **nodejs6**, **nodejs4.4**, **python3.10**, **python3.9**, **python3**, **python2.7**, **java11**, **java8**, **go1**, **php7.2**, **dotnetcore3.1**, **dotnetcore2.1**, **custom.debian10**, **custom**, and **custom-container**. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73338.html
parameters.help_zh: 函数运行的语言环境。目前支持**nodejs20**、**nodejs18**、**nodejs16**、**nodejs14**、**nodejs12**、**nodejs10**、**nodejs8**、**nodejs6**、**nodejs4.4**、**python3.10**、**python3.9**、**python3**、**python2.7**、**java11**、**java8**、**go1**、**php7.2**、**dotnetcore3.1**、**dotnetcore2.1**、**custom.debian10**、**custom**和**custom-container**。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73338.html
parameters.name: runtime

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for the function to run, in seconds. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 3. Function execution is terminated if it exceeds this time limit
parameters.help_zh: 函数运行的超时时间，单位为秒，最小1秒，默认3秒。函数超过这个时间后会被终止执行
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for the initializer function to run, in seconds. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 3. The initializer function is terminated if its execution exceeds this time limit
parameters.help_zh: 初始化函数运行的超时时间，单位为秒，最小1秒，默认3秒。初始化函数超过这个时间后会被终止执行
parameters.name: initialization_timeout

parameters.help_en: The entry point for the initializer function. The format varies based on the programming language. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157704.html
parameters.help_zh: 初始化函数执行的入口，具体格式和语言相关。详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157704.html
parameters.name: initializer

parameters.help_en: The listening port of the HTTP server for a custom runtime or a Custom Container runtime
parameters.help_zh: 自定义、自定义容器运行时HTTP Server的监听端口
parameters.name: ca_port

parameters.help_en: The maximum concurrency of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例最大并发度
parameters.name: instance_concurrency

parameters.help_en:
The soft concurrency of the instance. This is used for graceful scale-out. When the number of concurrent requests on an instance exceeds the soft concurrency, the instance scales out. For example, if your instance starts slowly, set a soft concurrency value to trigger scale-out in advance.

The value must be less than or equal to **instanceConcurrency**
parameters.help_zh:
实例软并发度，用于优雅扩容。当实例上的并发数超过软并发度时，会触发实例扩容。例如，您的实例启动较慢，可以通过设置合适的软实例并发度，提前启动实例。

取值小于或等于**instanceConcurrency**
parameters.name: instance_soft_concurrency

parameters.help_en:
The instance type of the function. Valid values:

- **e1**: elastic instance.

- **c1**: performance instance.

- **fc.gpu.tesla.1**: GPU-accelerated instance of the Tesla series.

- **fc.gpu.ampere.1**: GPU-accelerated instance of the Ampere series.

- **fc.gpu.ada.1**: GPU-accelerated instance of the Ada series.

- **g1**: same as **fc.gpu.tesla.1**
parameters.help_zh:
函数的实例类型，取值如下：
  * **e1**：弹性实例。
  * **c1**：性能实例。
  * **fc.gpu.tesla.1**：GPU Tesla 系列实例类型。
  * **fc.gpu.ampere.1**：GPU Ampere 系列实例类型。
  * **fc.gpu.ada.1**：GPU Ada 系列实例类型。
  * **g1**：同 **fc.gpu.tesla.1**
parameters.name: instance_type

fields.help_zh: 容器自定义健康检查URL地址。长度不超过2048个字符

fields.help_en: The duration after the container is started before health checks are initiated. Valid values: 0 to 120. Unit: seconds. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 容器启动到发起健康检查的延迟。取值范围0~120，单位为秒，默认值为0

fields.help_en: The threshold for health check failures. When this value is reached, the system considers the check failed. Valid values: 1 to 120. Unit: seconds. Default value: 3
fields.help_zh: 健康检查失败次数阈值，达到该值后系统认为检查失败。取值范围1~120，单位为秒，默认值为3

fields.help_zh: 健康检查成功次数阈值，达到该值后系统认为检查成功。取值范围1~120，单位为秒，默认值为1
